workspace.boundary.cancelAria: Screen-reader name of the cross button that discards the whole boundary drawing. Its hover text is the shared Cancel, not this string.
workspace.boundary.cancelPieceAria: Screen-reader name of the cross button that discards the piece being drawn. Its hover text is the shared Cancel, not this string.
workspace.boundary.closePiece: Button that closes the piece being drawn and starts the next one, for a boundary made of separate pieces. This one shows its label as text, not a symbol.
workspace.boundary.closePieceAria: Screen-reader name of that Close piece button.
workspace.boundary.confirmBarAria: Accessible name of the bar shown while drawing a separate piece of the forest boundary (screen readers only).
workspace.boundary.finish: Hover text of the tick button that saves the drawn forest boundary. The button shows only a tick.
workspace.boundary.finishAria: Screen-reader name of that tick button.
workspace.boundary.islandsDrawn: Line in that bar: how many separate boundary pieces (islands) are finished so far. {{count}} = the number of pieces.
workspace.boundary.islandsHint: Hint under that count, shown once at least one piece is finished: a boundary may be several separate pieces, and another can be drawn or the boundary saved now.
workspace.boundary.piecePointsInfo: Line in that bar: how many points are on the piece being drawn, and what dragging or deleting one does. {{count}} = the number of points.
workspace.draw.blockChip: Small chip in that bar, shown only when part of the shape fell outside the forest boundary: how much was cut off. {{ha}} = hectares clipped away, to 2 decimal places.
workspace.draw.cancelCreateAria: Screen-reader name of the cross button in that bar, which throws away the shape being drawn.
workspace.draw.cancelSubAreaAria: Screen-reader name of the cross button in that bar, which discards the sub-area being drawn.
workspace.draw.clippedNote: One of those remarks: part of the drawn shape was outside the forest boundary and was cut off. {{ha}} = hectares removed.
workspace.draw.confirmBarAria: Accessible name of the bar shown while drawing a new block or compartment from the map (screen readers only).
workspace.draw.createFailed: Error shown when the shape could not be created. {{type}} = Block or Compartment.
workspace.draw.created: Confirmation after a new unit is created from the drawn points. {{type}} = Block or Compartment, {{name}} = the name the system gave it, {{area}} = its area in hectares.
workspace.draw.createdWithNote: The same confirmation, plus what the system had to do to the shape. {{type}} = Block or Compartment, {{name}} = the name given, {{area}} = area in hectares, {{notes}} = one or more short remarks joined with semicolons.
workspace.draw.drawnChip: Small chip in that bar: the area of the shape as drawn. {{ha}} = hectares, to 2 decimal places.
workspace.draw.finishCreate: Hover text of the tick button in that bar, which creates the block or compartment from the points drawn. The button shows only a tick. Same wording as Finish elsewhere, so the reviewer can match it.
workspace.draw.finishCreateAria: Screen-reader name of that tick button.
workspace.draw.finishSubArea: Hover text of the tick button in that bar, which closes the sub-area. The button shows only a tick. Must be very short to fit the button.
workspace.draw.finishSubAreaAria: Screen-reader name of that tick button.
workspace.draw.minThreePoints: Warning when Finish is pressed with too few points: a shape needs at least 3.
workspace.draw.newFeatureHint: Advice shown when a new feature is started: click points on the map, and the shape will be cut to the forest boundary. {{type}} = what is being drawn, Block or Compartment.
workspace.draw.outsideBoundary: Error when the drawn shape lies wholly outside the forest boundary and so cannot be kept. {{type}} = what was being drawn, Block or Compartment.
workspace.draw.overlapsExisting: Error when the drawn shape lands on an area already covered by another one of the same kind. {{type}} = the kind of unit being drawn, said twice: once for the new shape and once for the existing one.
workspace.draw.pointsDrawnInfo: Line in that bar: how many points are placed so far, and what pressing the button will do. {{count}} = the number of points. {{type}} = what is being drawn, Block or Compartment.
workspace.draw.remainderNote: One of those remarks: the uncovered ground was turned into an extra unit so the block still fills its parent. {{type}} = Block or Compartment, {{ha}} = its area in hectares.
workspace.draw.subAreaConfirmBarAria: Accessible name of the bar shown while drawing a sub-area on the map (screen readers only).
workspace.draw.subAreaDrawnChip: Small chip in that bar: the area of the sub-area drawn so far. {{ha}} = hectares, to 2 decimal places. Identical to the Activity Features chip, so the two should read the same.
workspace.draw.subAreaPointsDrawnInfo: Line in that bar: how many points are placed so far, and what dragging or deleting one does. {{count}} = the number of points.
workspace.userGroup.cancelDrawAria: Screen-reader name of the cross button in that bar, which discards the user-group boundary being drawn.
workspace.userGroup.confirmBarAria: Accessible name of the bar shown while drawing a user-group boundary on the map (screen readers only).
workspace.userGroup.finishDraw: Hover text of the tick button in that bar, which closes the user-group boundary. The button shows only a tick, so keep it very short.
workspace.userGroup.finishDrawAria: Screen-reader name of that tick button.
workspace.userGroup.pointsDrawnInfo: Line in that bar: how many points are placed so far, and what dragging or deleting one does. {{count}} = the number of points.
